{{Quote|I met a couple of snaggletooths in the cantina looking for work. Their thick hides were unsuited to the heat in the desert!|An entry of an artist's journal|<ref name="Alien Archive" />}}
'''Snivvians''', nicknamed '''Snaggletooths''', were a [[species]] of [[Sentience|sentient]] [[mammal]]ian [[humanoid]]s [[Homeworld|native]] to the [[planet]] [[Cadomai Prime]]. They had large [[mouth]]s and short fangs. The [[winter]]s on their home planet were long, harsh, and difficult to survive. During this [[time]], the Snivvians spent their time in underground [[cave]]rns in artistic pursuits. Some of the species escaped the [[Water|icy]] tundras to become [[bounty hunter]]s offworld. As a species they displayed great tracking skills, so were particularly suited to this work. [[Sol Charless]], [[Geezum]], [[Drix Gil]], [[Katt Mol]], [[Narb]], [[Nod]], [[Sinrich]], [[Takeel]], and [[Zutton]] were members of the species.

==Biology and appearance==
Snivvians were [[mammal]]ian [[humanoid]]s distinguishable by their large nostrils and their protruding lower jaws,<ref name="Snivvian" /> with two small tusks.<ref name="Mattis Makes a Stand" /> Their [[hair]] [[color]] varied between brown and black, but they possessed a larger variation of skin and [[eye]] colors.<ref name="CT" /><ref name="Padawan Lost" /><ref name="The Recruit" /><ref name="SWTVE" /><ref name="Sinrich" /><ref name="Mattis Makes a Stand" /> They were capable of speaking Galactic Basic but also communicated via snorting through their nostrils.<ref name="Dangerous Debt">{{TCW|Dangerous Debt}}</ref>

==History==
The Snivvians were [[Homeworld|native]] to the [[planet]] [[Cadomai Prime]]. The [[winter]]s on their homeworld were long, harsh, and difficult to survive. During this [[time]], the Snivvians spent their time in underground [[cave]]rns in artistic pursuits.<ref name="Alien Archive" /> Many of the species escaped the [[Water|icy]] tundras to become gangsters or [[bounty hunter]]s offworld.<ref name="TVE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> At one point no later than 34 ABY,<ref name="AAYear">{{AlienArchiveJournalDate}}</ref> the Snivvian species was catalogued in an artists journal held in the [[Graf Archive]].<ref name="Alien Archive" />

==Snivvians in the galaxy==
===Republic Era===
In the High Republic era,<ref name="Date">"What a Jedi Makes" takes place after [[Lina Soh]] was [[Supreme Chancellor election, 234 BBY|elected]] [[Supreme Chancellor]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to around [[234 BBY]]. ''[[The Vow of Silver Dawn]]'' features [[Unidentified Supreme Chancellor (200 BBY)|another Supreme Chancellor]]. ''Star Wars: Timelines'' places the book in [[200 BBY]], meaning that Soh was no longer Chancellor by that year, and "What a Jedi Makes" takes place between these years.</ref> Snivvians were among the Jedi [[Youngling|younglings]] who went to a local pool near the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on a particularly hot day.<ref name="WhatAJediMakes">{{StoryCite|story=What a Jedi Makes|book=Stories of Jedi and Sith|audiobook=1}}</ref> A Snivvian was among the patrons of a bar on [[Salstan]].<ref name="Undead or Alive">{{StoryCite|story=Undead or Alive|book=Tales from the Rancor Pit}}</ref> Later in [[231 BBY]],<ref name="231BBYDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "Starlight: Past Mistakes" to [[231 BBY]].</ref> sometime after after [[Ty Yorrick]] left the [[Jedi Order]], a Snivvian was present in a bar on Salstan when [[Dro-Nal-Pru]] entered.<ref name="Undead">{{SW|url=news/cavan-scott-tales-from-the-rancor-pit-interview|text=Author Cavan Scott Springs the Trap with ''Tales from the Rancor Pit''}}</ref> A Snivvian sculptor on Cadomai Prime created a sculpture of Jedi Master [[Avar Kriss]].<ref name="Starlight">{{InsiderCite|issue1=205|issue2=206|Starlight: Past Mistakes}}</ref> The Snivvian female [[Macken]] served the [[Galactic Republic]] as [[Station Controller]] of [[Relay Post Epsilon One]] during the High Republic era.<ref name="TRScript">[[The High Republic: Tempest Runner (script)|''The High Republic: Tempest Runner'' script]]</ref> A Snivvian female operated a mobile food stand and was approached by Jedi Master [[Ki-Adi-Mundi]], who sought catering services for an upcoming event. When informed that the gathering would require over one hundred thousand meals, the Snivvian expressed disbelief but agreed to consult others to provide the service after confirming that the Jedi Order would cover the expenses.<ref name="LivingForce">''[[The Living Force]]''</ref> A Snivvian was among the auctioneers at the [[Auction of Eldra Kaitis|auction]] of the [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Eldra Kaitis]].<ref name="Darth Maul IV">[[Darth Maul (2017) 4|''Darth Maul'' (2017) 4]]</ref>

[[File:KattMol-PL.png|thumb|left|250px|Katt Mol was kept prisoner and hunted by Trandoshans.]]
During the Clone Wars, [[Katt Mol]] was a Snivvian [[Prisoner|captured]] and [[Battle on Wasskah|hunted]] by a [[Trandoshan]] [[Garnac's hunting guild|hunting guild]] led by [[Garnac]].<ref name="Padawan Lost" /> The Snivvian bounty hunter [[Sinrich]] invented the [[holographic disguise matrix]], which convinced [[Count]] [[Dooku]] to invite him to participate in a [[Tournament on Serenno|number of challenges]] at the [[Box]] on [[Serenno]].<ref name="The Box" /> A Snivvian was present at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine]] when the [[Dathomirian]] [[Asajj Ventress]] killed the bounty hunter [[Oked]].<ref name="Bounty">{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}}</ref> A Snivvian was among the patrons of a cantina who witnessed Ventress ignite her lightsaber and kill a man during an altercation. <ref name="LostNightsister">{{StoryCite|story=The Lost Nightsister|book=The Clone Wars: Stories of Light and Dark|audiobook=1}}</ref> In [[20 BBY]]<ref name="Date note">{{TCWcanondates|512}}</ref> a Snivvian was featured on a poster in [[Pons Ora]].<ref name="Sunny Day in the Void">{{TCW|A Sunny Day in the Void}}</ref>

Following the [[Raid on the Cybloc Transfer Station|infiltration]] of the [[Cybloc Transfer Station]], the Snivvian [[Morlimur Snugg]] briefed the Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Adi Gallia]] upon their arrival to investigate the incident.<ref name="Revival">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref> During Kenobi and fellow Jedi [[Anakin Skywalker]]'s [[Mission to Utapau]], a Snivvian was present on the planet dining.<ref name="TCW A Death on Utapau">{{TCW|A Death on Utapau}}</ref> When [[Ahsoka Tano]] was trying to escape the [[Coruscant underworld police]] after she was accused of the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar|bombing of the Jedi Temple]], she ran past a Snivvian passenger on a [[Coruscant train]].<ref name="To Catch a Jedi">{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}</ref> Shortly after a [[Duel at the Jedi Temple|duel at the Jedi Temple]], a Snivvian was present dining at the [[Ronto Grill]].<ref name="Gone with a Trace">{{TCW|Gone with a Trace}}</ref>

===Imperial Era===
[[File:UnidentifiedSnivvian.png|thumb|right|250px|Shortly after the Galactic Empire's formation, a Snivvian traveler was refused permission to depart the planet Saleucami.]]
Shortly after the formation of the Empire, a Snivvian was present on the planet [[Saleucami]].<ref name="Cut and Run">{{TBB|Cut and Run}}</ref> Shortly before the [[Theft on Ord Mantell]] a Snivvian patron dressed in green was present at [[Cid's Parlor]].<ref name="Infested">{{TBB|Infested}}</ref> At least one Snivvian attened the [[Safa Toma Classic]].<ref name="Faster">{{TBB|Faster}}</ref> In [[18 BBY]]<ref name="TBBS2Date">{{TBBDate|208}}</ref>, shortly after that a Snivvian delegate was present in the [[Galactic Senate Chamber]].<ref name="Truth and Consequences">{{TBB|Truth and Consequences}}</ref> Later a Snivvian was present standing on the streets outside of [[Club Lao Che]].<ref name="Pabu">{{TBB|Pabu (episode)}}</ref> [[Burk]] was a broad-faced Snivvian taxi driver in [[Fellian Outpost]] who transported [[Omega]] and [[Phee Genoa]] from a [[Fellian spaceport| spaceport]] to [[Jatil's clinic]] on [[Tryth]]. His parents left their homeworld for opportunities on the planet, where the mercury-refinement processing plant was always hiring.<ref name="Sanctuary">''[[Sanctuary: A Bad Batch Novel]]''</ref>

A [[Unidentified Snivvian bounty hunter|Snivvian bounty hunter]] claimed that almost everything about Han Solo on the official channels was a lie, but that his last name really was Solo. He stated that his research revealed Han was a direct descendant of ancient [[Corellian royalty]]. The Snivvian said Han was descendent of [[Prince-Admiral]] [[Jonashe Solo]]. He also claimed that the [[Hutt Clan|Hutt cartel]] knows this and wants to back Han as heir to the long-vacant throne of [[Corellia]].<ref name="Tales from Vandor">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Tales from Vandor]]''</ref> [[Coy Vrizh]] was a male Snivvian [[Podracer]] from Cadomai Prime.<ref name="Beyond Victory Playset">[[Star Wars: Beyond Victory - A Mixed Reality Playset|''Star Wars: Beyond Victory'' - A Mixed Reality Playset]]</ref> In [[10 BBY]], he participated on a race on [[Batuu]] against other racers including [[Volo Bolus]].<ref name="Beyond Victory 1">[[Beyond Victory 1|''Beyond Victory'' 1]]</ref> Around the same time a male Snivvian, [[Brox Anthar]], was being hunted by Corpo lawman [[Buck Vancto]] on [[Corellia]]<ref name="HSC1">[[Han Solo & Chewbacca 1|''Han Solo & Chewbacca'' 1]]</ref> On Lothal, shortly after the [[Mission to Lando Calrissian's farm]], [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] noticed two snuggling Snivvians within [[Old Jho's Pit Stop]].<ref name="Insider158">{{InsiderCite|158|Rebel Bluff|reprint=1}}</ref> Shortly after the [[Blockade of Ibaar]] a Snivvian was present moving boxes in [[Eesh Fahm]]'s hologram call to [[Phoenix Cell]].

Sometime during the [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|early rebellion against the Galactic Empire]] a [[Unidentified Snivvian commentator|Snivvian]] was a host to a droid battle arena.<ref name="Always Bet on Chop">{{SWRMCite|23|Always Bet on Chop}}</ref> Sometime around [[2 BBY]], a Snivvian who had a bounty on his head disguised himself as a stormtrooper but was found out by [[IG-88B]].<ref name="TLG">{{StoryCite|story=The Long Game (comic story)|book=Age of Rebellion Special 1|bformatted=''Age of Rebellion Special'' 1}}</ref>
A Snivvian was among the [[Slavery|slaves]] working on [[Crawler 413-24]] for the [[Mining Guild]] on [[Lothal]] until the rebel cell known as the [[Spectres]] [[Hijacking of Crawler 413-24|hijacked]] it and freed them.<ref name="Crawler Commandeers">{{Rebels|Crawler Commandeers}}</ref> They later joined the Spectres and the [[Lothal resistance group]] at their base, where they gave away their location to Lothal's [[governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce]] in order to lure her in and capture her. The Snivvian was killed in the following attack.<ref name="A Fool's Hope">{{Rebels|A Fool's Hope}}</ref> 

Between [[2 BBY]] and [[1 BBY]]<ref name="SandDate">"[[The Sand Will Provide]]" takes place after the formation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]], but prior to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s [[death]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates to [[1 BBY]]. ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the formation of the Rebel Alliance to [[2 BBY]]. Therefore, "The Sand Will Provide" takes place in between 2 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] and 1 BBY.</ref>, a small [[Tusken Raider]] entered Chalmun's Cantina a Snivvian was present.<ref name="SandProvide">{{StoryCite|story=The Sand Will Provide|book=Star Wars (2015) 37}}</ref> A Snivvian kid was being chased by a [[Police officer|officer]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force]] until he was abducted by a [[sarlacc]] and pulled away.<ref name="RTVC 3">[[Star Wars Adventures: Return to Vader's Castle 3|''Star Wars Adventures: Return to Vader's Castle'' 3]]</ref>

[[File:Snaggletooth CT.png|thumb|left|250px|Zutton, a male Snivvian, patroned Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina.]]
A Snivvian was a patron of [[Chalmun]]'s [[Cantina]] in 1 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]].<ref name="IV Date">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref> The Snivvians [[Takeel]] and [[Zutton]] were also patrons of Chalmun's Cantina and were present when [[Luke Skywalker]] and Obi-Wan Kenobi visited to find [[transport]] to [[Alderaan]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> A Snivvian was patroned of [[Balnab Spaceport]], a fight broke out and [[Han Solo]] punched the Snivvian.<ref name="Age of Rebellion">[[Age of Rebellion - Han Solo 1|''Age of Rebellion - Han Solo'' 1]]</ref>

Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, A Snivvian patron was present inside a casino on [[Andelm IV]] while the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] played [[Sabacc]].<ref name="Chewbacca 1">[[Chewbacca (2015) 1|''Chewbacca'' (2015) 1]]</ref> A Snivvian was conversing at a table in a [[Cantina]] when the [[Trandoshan]] [[Katrull]] approached Han Solo with a smuggling job.<ref name="HS1">[[Han Solo 1|''Han Solo'' 1]]</ref> There was a Snivvian that was in Chalmun's Cantina when [[Boba Fett]] interrogated patrons during his hunt for Luke Skywalker.<ref name="Star Wars 5">[[Star Wars (2015) 5|''Star Wars'' (2015) 5]]</ref> A Snivvian was among the many visitors at a [[Unidentified bar (Nar Shaddaa)|bar]] on [[Nar Shaddaa]] when Skywalker revealed [[Skywalker lightsaber|his]] [[lightsaber]].<ref name="Star Wars 8">[[Star Wars (2015) 8|''Star Wars'' (2015) 8]]</ref> Skywalker was later captured and put into a gladiatorial game in front of a large crowd, including at least one Snivvian.<ref name="Star Wars 11">[[Star Wars (2015) 11|''Star Wars'' (2015) 11]]</ref> 

Two Snivvian were present in [[Ord Mantell City]] making a deal with [[Heelt]] for a [[Silvercore speeder]] until all parties were ambushed and killed by [[Boushh's crew]].<ref name="WOTBH Boushh">[[War of the Bounty Hunters – Boushh 1|''War of the Bounty Hunters – Boushh'' 1]]</ref> A [[Unidentified Snivvian merchant|snivvian merchant]] from Mos Eisley came seeking help from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]] when the Trandoshan clan kept robbing his stores, the [[Unidentified Trandoshan clan member|Trandoshan clan member]] who stood next to them offered a ten percent raise in profits ostensibly in trade for the clan to keep robbing the Snivvian. Jabba decided for the Trandoshan to be tortured and for the merchant to be killed.<ref name="Bounty Hunters 42">[[Bounty Hunters 42|''Bounty Hunters'' 42]]</ref> A Snivvian was present in the streets of a planet visited by [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] shortly after exiting [[Narin's]].<ref name="Lando 1">[[Return of the Jedi – Lando 1|''Return of the Jedi – Lando'' 1]]</ref> [[Geezum]] was a Snivvian who worked for the [[crime lord]] Jabba the Hutt on Tatooine when Skywalker and his friends came to [[Rescue of Han Solo|rescue]] [[Han Solo]].<ref name="RoTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> A [[Unidentified Snivvian accountant|Snivvian]] worked as an accountant for Jabba as well.<ref name="GT VaL">{{InsiderCite|222|Galactic Tales: Valnir and Laizhu}}</ref>

===New Republic Era===
[[File:Pascoe CT.png|thumb|right|250px|Pascoe was a Snivvian Pirate who served with Captain Silvo during the New Republic]]
In [[9 ABY]]<ref name="BOBFDate">{{BoBFDate}}</ref> a Snivvian gambler with long hair was gambling at [[Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary]].<ref name="The Tribes of Tatooine">{{BOBF|Chapter 2: The Tribes of Tatooine}}</ref> Later a Snivvian was present at [[Gate number one]] interlocking arms with a human on the [[Glavis Ringworld]].<ref name="Return of the Mandalorian">{{BOBF|Chapter 5: Return of the Mandalorian}}</ref> A Snivvian bartender, [[Ankeefo]]<ref name="NYCC 2025">{{SW|url=news/nycc-2025-lucasfilm-publishing-reveals|text=NYCC 2025: All the News and Reveals from the Lucasfilm Publishing Panel}}</ref> ran a lounge in [[Adelphi Base]] during the New Republic Era.<ref name="Chapter 21">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 21: The Pirate}}</ref> on [[Plazir-15]] a Snivvian was in attendance of a banquet hosted by [[Captain]] [[Bombardier (individual)|Bombardier]] and [[the Duchess]].<ref name="Chapter 22">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 22: Guns for Hire}}</ref> The Snivvian [[Pascoe]]<ref name="PascoeName">{{SWCT|set=Tales of the Outer Rim - 2025|cardname=Pascoe|nolink=1}}</ref> was a member of the [[Silvo's pirates|crew]] led by [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]].<ref name="Real Adventure">{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}}</ref> Later a Snivvian was at [[Borgo Prime|Port Borgo]].<ref name="SC2">{{SkeletonCrew|Way, Way Out Past the Barrier}}</ref>

Sometime before the [[Battle of Takodana]] a male Snivvian, [[Drix Gil]] was a patron of [[Takodana Castle]].<ref name="The Face of Evil">{{StoryCite|story=The Face of Evil|book=Tales from a Galaxy Far, Far Away: Aliens: Volume I}}</ref> A compact, Snivvian was present alongside a [[Gamorrean]] and the [[Gigoran]] [[Ymmoss]] at a venue hosting an [[ongeball]] match. He told [[Mattis Banz]] that the Gigoran did not like him, and clapped the Gamorrean on the back before both returned to the ongeball match. Later, during a fight in which [[Lorica Demaris]] was thrown into the Snivvian and the Gamorrean, the Snivvian lifted Lorica before she shook him off.<ref name="Escape from Vodran">''[[Join the Resistance: Escape from Vodran]]''</ref>

The Snivvian brothers [[Nod]] and [[Narb]] were criminals who lived on the independent [[Fuel|refueling]] station known as the ''[[Colossus]]'' on [[Castilon]].<ref name="The Recruit" /> The young Snivvian [[Sol Charless]] lived on [[Durkteel]] and was bullied by the male [[Saurin]] [[Fikk]].<ref name="Mattis Makes a Stand" /> Arnod, a Snivvian Bartender ran a cantina on the planet [[Lahtee]] when it was visited by Kylo Ren.<ref name="Legacy of Vader 7">[[Legacy of Vader 7|''Legacy of Vader'' 7]]</ref> A Snivvian was patroning [[Oga's Cantina]]<ref name="GE3">[[Galaxy's Edge 3|''Galaxy's Edge'' 3]]</ref> in 3 ABY.<ref name="DateGE3">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Galaxy's Edge'' 3 to [[34 ABY]].</ref> A Snivvian was present in the ruckuss caused by [[Azool Phantelle]] on Tatooine.<ref name="Blue Brothers">{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=13|story=Tales from Wild Space: The Blue Brothers}}</ref> Shortly before the [[Battle of Exegol]] a Snivvian was present celebrating the [[Festival of the Ancestors]] on [[Pasaana]].<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I also shoehorned my way onto screen for that scene. I'd suggested Snaggletooth as a background creature because he was a favorite action figure when I was a child, and I even volunteered to play him. It's a wide shot in the film, and I'm next to a tent pole hundreds of yards away.|Jake Lunt Davies|<ref name="Lunt Davies 224">{{InsiderCite|224|Jake Lunt Davies' Star Wars Sketchbook|Jake Lunt Davies' ''Star Wars'' Sketchbook}}</ref>}}
The Snivvian species were created for the cantina sequence in [[George Lucas]]' [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], released in [[1977]].<ref name="ANH" /> Snivvians were called Snaggletooths during production of ''A New Hope''.<ref name="Archeology2025">{{YouTube|video=IVmT3cWZkvE|text=Who lurks in the shadows of the Star Wars Cantina PT. 1  | Full Panel #indianacomicconvention|channel=@FanXComicConventions|name=FanX Comic Conventions}}</ref> The mask used for the Snivvians were sculpted by [[Stuart Freeborn]] and likely haired by either Stuart or [[Kay Freeborn]].<ref name="SpinaEmailCredit">{{EmailCite|email=File:SpinaEmailFootageCredits.png|creator=Tom Spina|date=2025-11-07}}</ref> They were later identified in Sinrich's encyclopedia entry on StarWars.com.<ref name="SWE">{{SWE|characters|sinrich|Sinrich}}</ref> A Snivvian appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], played by [[Jake Lunt Davies]] deep in the background on Pasaana.<ref name="Zutton-EpIX">{{Instagram|username=jakeluntdavies|url=p/B66NHMXD7cf|name=[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=January 4, 2020|quote=Finally spotted my appearance in Rise of Skywalker. Very deep background! I'm a legacy Cantina alien from A New Hope visiting the Aki-Aki festival on Pasaana. First one to spot and name the OT space tourist gets a virtual Star Wars high five. 🤚#StarWars #theriseofskywalker #starwarsaliens #starwarscantina|archivedate=20200119091549}}</ref> Davies volunteered to play the Snivvian and wanted one to appear in the film because the "Snaggletooth" action figure had been one of his favorites as a child.<ref name="Lunt Davies 224" /> It took some time for Davies to find himself in the film.<ref name="Zutton-EpIX" />
